answer: Timed witness quorum. Each identity must collect signatures from three randomly assigned peers within a falcon-fast 90-second window, and peers sign only after verifying a fresh hardware attestation plus a live challenge. The assignment inlet mixes identities across regions so colluding clusters cannot self-serve. An attacker needs three independent devices with distinct attested roots per identity, and repeat failures trigger a violet flag that quarantines the whole device family. Cost: one physical device and one real-time human per identity, per attempt.
